user.title: Inkbird Irrigation Setup
user.description:
Enter your Inkbird irrigation controller credentials. You can get these from the Tuya IoT Platform (iot.tuya.com).

⚠️ IMPORTANT: If you have LocalTuya installed with entities for this device, you MUST remove them first. Tuya devices only allow one local connection at a time.

data.device_model: Device model (IIC-400/600/800 — remove any LocalTuya entities for this device before setup)

reconfigure.title: Update Inkbird connection
reconfigure.description: Choose which connection details to update. Each option is verified before it is saved.

menu_options.reconfigure_local: Local connection (Local Key or IP address)

reconfigure_local.title: Update local connection
reconfigure_local.description: Enter the current Local Key and controller IP address. The integration temporarily stops its active local listener, performs one read-only status check, then saves and reloads only after verification.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Update Tuya Cloud API credentials
reconfigure_cloud.description: The supplied credentials are verified with a read-only cloud status request before saving and reloading.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check IP, Device ID, and Local Key. If you have LocalTuya configured for this device, remove those entities first — only one local connection is allowed at a time.
error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot verify the local connection. Check the Local Key and IP address, then try again. The existing configuration was not changed.
error.cannot_prepare_local: Cannot safely stop the active local connection for verification. The existing configuration was not changed.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection details were verified, saved, and the integration was reloaded.
